delay.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The delay between playlist tracks.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#speaker_sourceset_playlist_delay-action)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The speaker source media player to control.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#speaker_sourceset_playlist_delay-action)*

pipeline.docs:
**enum**: Which pipeline to set the delay for. One of `media` or `announcement`.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#speaker_sourceset_playlist_delay-action)*

set_playlist_delay.docs: This action sets the delay between consecutive tracks in a pipeline's playlist. This can be useful to add a pause between announcement files or between media tracks.

announcement_pipeline.docs:
**Pipeline Schema**: Configuration settings for the announcement pipeline. Same options as `media_pipeline`. Must use a different speaker than `media_pipeline`.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#configuration-variables)*

media_pipeline.docs:
**Pipeline Schema**: Configuration settings for the media pipeline. At least one of `media_pipeline` or `announcement_pipeline` is required.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#configuration-variables)*

on_mute.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when muted.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#configuration-variables)*

on_unmute.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when unmuted.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#configuration-variables)*

on_volume.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the volume is changed.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#configuration-variables)*

volume_increment.docs:
**percentage**: Increment amount that the `media_player.volume_up` and `media_player.volume_down` actions will increase or decrease volume by. Defaults to `5%`.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#configuration-variables)*

volume_initial.docs:
**percentage**: The default volume used on first boot when no volume has been previously saved. Defaults to `50%`.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#configuration-variables)*

volume_max.docs:
**percentage**: The maximum volume allowed. Defaults to `100%`.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#configuration-variables)*

volume_min.docs:
**percentage**: The minimum volume allowed. Defaults to `0%`.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#configuration-variables)*

format.docs:
**enum**: The audio format Home Assistant will transcode audio to before sending it to the device. One of `FLAC`, `MP3`, `OPUS`, `WAV`, or `NONE`. `NONE` disables transcoding in Home Assistant; ESPHome will then compile support for all supported codecs (`FLAC`, `MP3`, `OPUS`, and `WAV`), which increases firmware size. To compile in additional codecs without setting this to `NONE`, use the [Audio](https://esphome.io/components/audio/) component. Defaults to `FLAC`.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#configuration-variables)*

num_channels.docs:
**positive integer**: Number of channels for the transcoded audio. Must be either `1` or `2`. Defaults to the speaker's number of channels.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#configuration-variables)*

sample_rate.docs:
**positive integer**: Sample rate for the transcoded audio. Should be supported by the configured `speaker` component. Defaults to the speaker's sample rate. The `OPUS` codec only supports a `48000` sample rate.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#configuration-variables)*

sources.docs:
**list of [IDs](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: A list of [media source](https://esphome.io/components/media_source/) component IDs to use for this pipeline. At least one source is required. When a media URL is received, the pipeline finds the first source that can handle the URI prefix. Each source can only belong to one pipeline; if both pipelines need the same type of source, configure separate instances.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#configuration-variables)*

speaker.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The [speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/) to output the audio.

*See also: [Speaker Source Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/speaker_source#configuration-variables)*
